x: It is not the luck of all runners to be a Scrimshaw, but strict training and plenty of enthusiasm will often work wonders; and gain the same position for us in Track athletics that has already been attained by our walkers and cross country men. Our sprinters might well emulate the example of M.
The Inter-Club Scratch Walks of 1928 were won by Belgrave with 77 points; Ashcombe A.C. taking second place with 64 points. The Club Championships were won as follows: 100 yards, M.
